pick.name: Lyssna (free)
pick.what: Unmoderated tests: first-click, preference, five-second, prototype tests
pick.why: Most usable free tier (unlimited quick studies, 3 seats) and pay-per-use panel when you need strangers.
pick.free_limits: Free: 3 seats, 15 self-recruited responses (per-study vs total not stated). Growth $166/mo

alts.name: UXtweak (free)
alts.why: Similar free tier; 15 responses/mo, 1 study at a time.
alts.free_limits: 1 seat, 15 responses/mo, 1 concurrent study, unmoderated only; per-study caps 10 (survey/card sort/tree test) or 3 (first-click/prototype/five-second); results visible 14 days

alts.name: Maze
alts.why: Best if designs live in Figma; free limits not shown.
alts.free_limits: Free limits not shown on the page

decision: For a solo founder, five moderated calls beat any tool; Lyssna's free tier covers quick unmoderated checks. Pay for a panel only when recruiting from your own audience fails.
